account.signInDesc: Sign in to sync daily stats to the web dashboard and view trends across devices.
account.privacyNote: Only anonymous aggregates (domain + duration) are synced. Raw URLs never leave your device.

privacy.storageNote: All data is stored on your device and never uploaded

privacy.deleteDesc: Delete all tracking records, daily stats, and AI analyses. Settings and account data are kept.

about.appDesc: Privacy-first productivity tracker that automatically records your browsing behavior, analyzes work patterns with Gemini AI, and delivers personalized improvement suggestions.
about.privacyItem0: All browsing data is stored only on your device (chrome.storage.local)
about.privacyItem1: AI analysis uses only anonymous aggregates (domain + duration — no full URLs)
about.privacyItem2: Raw URLs and page titles never leave your device
about.privacyItem3: Account data is securely encrypted via Supabase
about.copyright: © 2025 EchoFocus — Powered by Google Gemini AI
